## Background

<!-- CHANGE THIS -->

I come from Hangzhou, Zhejiang, in China — a picturesque city with friendly
people, many excellent dessert shops, and streets that are especially friendly
to cyclists. What I love most is riding my road bike through the city and
feeling its pulse as I go.

That's what drew me to urban spatial analytics. A city is a complex system,
and I want to understand it better — how its pieces fit together, move, and
interact. This program is my way of learning to read the city I've been
riding through all along.
